Privacy Policy

Preview policy · 20 October 2026

Contents

  1. Your details
  2. Browser storage
  3. WhatsApp
  4. Your choices

1. Information you provide

The enquiry form asks for your name, WhatsApp number and chosen plan, advertising account or bundle. This preview does not send that form to a server or to the reference provider.

2. Browser storage

Your currency preference is kept in local browser storage. Enquiry details are kept in session storage in this browser tab. You can clear this information through your browser settings or close the tab to clear the enquiry. This preview includes no advertising pixels or analytics scripts.

3. Sharing an enquiry

When a Fabrica Invest WhatsApp contact is configured, you may choose to open WhatsApp with a prefilled message. Nothing is sent until you send it in WhatsApp. WhatsApp processes the information under its own privacy policy.

4. Your choices and contact

You may browse without submitting the enquiry form. Business contact details and data-request procedures will be supplied by Fabrica Invest before the store accepts orders.

5. Hosting and third-party assets

The site uses Sites hosting. Fonts, tool icons and payment logos are served with the site. The hosting service may process technical request data needed to deliver and secure the website.
